agenda_items.description:
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; in camera meeting procedures; information items not subject to discussion; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and hybrid participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
Except where otherwise indicated, reports requiring Council consideration will be presented to Council on Wednesday, October 30, 2024, in Community Services Committee Report 12.
The deadline to register by phone to speak, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on Monday, October 21, 2024, and the deadline to register to speak by email is 8:30 am on Tuesday, October 22, 2024.

sub_agendas_items.title: Ottawa’s Poverty Reduction Strategy 2025 - 2029

attachments.attachment_title: English Report - Ottawa’s Poverty Reduction Strategy 2025-2029 AODA.pdf
French Report - Ottawa’s Poverty Reduction Strategy 2025-2029 AODA.pdf

sub_agendas_items.description:
The report for this item was published on October 11, 2024, after the publication of the agenda on October 10, 2024. Committee will consider a motion to approve the addition of the report to the agenda and allow consideration of the item at its meeting of October 22, 2024, pursuant to subsection 89(3) of the Procedure By-law.
File No. ACS2024-CSS-GEN-010 – City-wide
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Clara Freire, General Manager, Community and Social Services Department, and Sarah Taylor, Director, Community Safety, Well-Being, Policy and Analytics, presented an overview of the report and answered questions from the Committee.  A copy of the slide presentation is filed with the Office of the City Clerk. Sawsan Al-Refaei, Manager, Strategic Projects, also answered questions.
The following external stakeholders co-presented with staff:
Committee received the following submissions, and a copy of each is filed with the Office of the City Clerk:
The following members of the public spoke before the Committee and provided comments on the report:
After discussion on this item, the Committee considered the following:

motions.motion_text:
WHEREAS the report for this item was published on October 11, 2024, after the publication of the agenda on October 10, 2024;
BE IT RESOLVED THAT the Community Services Committee approve the addition of the report for consideration at today’s meeting, pursuant to subsection 89(3) of the Procedure By-law (being by-law no. 2022-410) to allow for timely consideration of the matter.

Report recommendation(s)
That Community Services Committee recommend that Council approve the Poverty Reduction Strategy as outlined in this report and supporting documentation therein to achieve the first step in the Term of Council strategic objective “advance poverty reduction.”

sub_agendas_items.title: Canada-Ontario Community Housing Benefits 2024-2025
sub_agendas_items.description:
The report for this item was published on October 16, 2024, after the publication of the agenda on October 10, 2024. Committee will consider a motion to approve the addition of the report to the agenda and allow consideration of the item at its meeting of October 22, 2024, pursuant to subsection 89(3) of the Procedure By-law.
File No. ACS2024-CSS-GEN-014 – City-wide
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Kale Brown, Director, Housing, answered questions from the Committee. 
There were no submissions on this item.
After discussion, the Committee considered the following:

motions.motion_text:
WHEREAS the report for this item was published on October 16, 2024, after the publication of the agenda on October 10, 2024;
BE IT RESOLVED THAT the Community Services Committee approve the addition of the report for consideration at today’s meeting, pursuant to subsection 89(3) of the Procedure By-law (being by-law no. 2022-410) to allow for timely consideration of the matter.

Report recommendation(s)
That Community Services Committee recommend Council approve that the Director, Housing & Homelessness Services continue to administer the Canada-Ontario Housing Benefit Program in accordance with the provincial guidelines, and the priorities as set out in this report.
